global.criterion: Premium compact sculpted 3D educational cartoon miniature in S1-01 style on warm off-white, with plausible materials and clean margins; no photographic disaster scene or toy-faced person.
No embedded words, numerals, arrows, fake writing, warning text, source school/Spark identity, brand, logo or watermark.
No visible person, hand, injured body, active real chemical, plume, emergency treatment, rescue or universal response instruction.

s103-video-evacuate.criterion: A clear route runs from field-store model to a neutral junction without crossing the fenced hazard zone; there is no return path for a missing person.
Separate open assembly-board and enclosed shelter props are alternatives; no depicted hazard makes outdoor assembly universally correct.
Blank attendance-token rack has one empty slot and a nearby coordinator call point, without a person hidden in the hazard area.
Low path-level perspective differs from a future elevated whole-site reading map.

s103-video-cases.criterion: Four physically spaced prop islands clearly show unused eyewash/blank bottle, shade/cooling gear, TINY grass-partly-hidden shallow ankle-ground irregularity no deeper than one shoe sole and smaller than a cone base (no pit or excavation) with unused kit, and separate screened unknown-air zone.
Eyewash is not placed inside the unknown-air boundary; cooling water does not appear administered to a confused person; no casualty, chemical exposure or hazardous rescue is shown.
In fourth pod a broad pale path visibly turns AWAY from the solid screened unknown-air boundary to an outer safe edge; it does not lead into or terminate at the screen.
Each prop island has enough margin to be cropped alone for narration while retaining its case context; no embedded caption or quadrant label.
